unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded comment on issue #650 (calibrate pubnet daily fee ceiling): the ceiling exists because the facilitator pays the Stellar fee, making it a daily-budget problem and a bounded-loss surface for a compromised key. A zero-fee rail (Nano XNO) removes that whole class of risk at the source - no fee ceiling, no feeSpd budget, no per-key fee-loss. Offered to draft an additive nano:mainnet exact scheme as a separate issue, leaving the Stellar calibration untouched.
